SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT E.*, F.FILECATEGORYNAME, F.FILECATEGORYNO, C.ORGNAME AS ARCHIVEORGNAME, O.USERNAME AS REGISTERUSERNAME, U.USERNAME AS DEPARTMENTUSERNAME, S.USERNAME AS AUDITUSERNAME, M.USERNAME AS APPROVEUSERNAME FROM T_EMC_FILE E LEFT JOIN T_EMC_FILE_CATEGORY F ON E.FILECATEGORYID = F.ID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_ORG C ON E.ARCHIVEORGID = C.ID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_USER O ON E.REGISTERUSERID = O.ID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_USER U ON E.DEPARTMENTUSERID = U.ID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_USER S ON E.AUDITUSERID = S.ID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_USER M ON E.APPROVEUSERID = M.ID) T
ORDER BY
T.ID DESC

SELECT T.*, C.ORGNAME AS ARCHIVEORGNAME, O.USERNAME AS REGISTERUSERNAME, U.USERNAME AS DEPARTMENTUSERNAME, S.USERNAME AS AUDITUSERNAME, M.USERNAME AS APPROVEUSERNAME FROM T_EMC_FILE T LEFT JOIN T_CORE_ORG C ON T.ARCHIVEORGID = C.ID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_USER O ON T.REGISTERUSERID = O.ID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_USER U ON T.DEPARTMENTUSERID = U.ID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_USER S ON T.AUDITUSERID = S.ID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_USER M ON T.APPROVEUSERID = M.ID WHERE T.ID = #{id}
